Welcome to the SecSpider DNSSEC monitoring project! Our goal is to provide comprehensive and histroical monitoring of the global rollout of DNSSEC. We have been tracking the global deployment since its very early stages in 2005.

Click here to see the current status of the global deployment of DNSSEC.

News
SecSpider 2.0 Released - October 22, 2007
The new distributed version of SecSpider has been released. Now all zones are polled from polling locations around the world.
